summary.content:
Today's selection covers 91 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 61 on Artificial Intelligence and 8 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Authors Wrangle With Publishers Over $1.5 Billion Anthropic A.I. Settlement
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Elementor Pro WordPress Plugin Vulnerability Exploited to Hack Sites
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights data breaches, scams, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, The Verge, BleepingComputer, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 12 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.title: Authors Wrangle With Publishers Over $1.5 Billion Anthropic A.I. Settlement
top.description: The tech giant must pay $3,000 per pirated book that it used to train its chatbot. Many authors fear they could lose funds to others in the book business.
